## Standing operator rules
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- “All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.”
- “Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.”
- Staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3; cache-eu-1 must not receive writes.
- Run migration steps in order, one at a time: `git status --short && test -f .travis.yml && echo 'working tree checked; .travis.yml found'`; `git switch -c gha/test-workflow`; `ruby -ryaml -e 'p YAML.load_file(".travis.yml").slice("language","node_js","script","cache")'`; `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'`; `printf '%s\n' 'on: [push,pull_request]' 'jobs: {test: {runs-on: ubuntu-24.04, steps: [{run: npm ci},{run: npm test}]}}' > .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'created .github/workflows/test.yml'`; `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'`; commit, push, then `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'`.

## Current objective
Fix dunning reminders emailing paid customers.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: stuck jobs became invisible for hours.
- Do not change legacy invoice rounding behavior.
- Popping events before persistence: failed persistence lost retryable events.

## Recent work
GHA workflow committed (`4f8c2a1`); push and Travis disable remain. Shared billing filters deduplicated; focused tests passed (`37 passed, 0 failed`), Ruff clean. Webhook retry code was located but not inspected.
